title: Decatur Street jobs, Harold Dejean, S.S. Dixie trips, meeting Pichon
summary: He played Decatur Street dives during the Depression and the Gypsy Tea Room with Kid Renee, joined his cousin Harold Dejean, explains his nickname, travels to New York on the S.S. Dixie, and meets Fats Pichon.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
